newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was active, with live sales fully steady; dressed basis fully steady to $1.00 higher, USDA said. Confirmed - 33,400 Last Week - 15,500 Last Year - 37,900 Wk To Date- 93,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 74,100 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 56,700
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs - 64.00-65.00, few Choice blacks 65.50; dressed basis 104.00-105.00, few 103.50. (weighted average 104.23).
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs - 64.00-65.00; dressed basis often 104.00, some to 103.00 and 105.00. (weighted average 104.07).

Demand and seller interest uneven through the day, but good at the close. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
